title: Airy Flaky Northern Irish Scones Afternoon Tea
description: A delicate and romantic Northern Irish dish featuring flaky scones with a floral twist, perfect for afternoon tea, made with malt vinegar and incorporating anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients through the use of mantecare emulsification.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the cold butter to the dry ingredients and use a pastry blender or fingers to work it into the mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
In a small bowl, whisk together the malt vinegar, heavy cream, dried rose petals, and honey.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until the dough comes together in a shaggy mass.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and gently knead it a few times until it comes together.
Pat the dough into a circle that is about 1 inch thick.
Use a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out scones.
Place the scones on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the scones with a little extra heavy cream and sprinkle with sugar.
